rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Superior Electoral Court's diploma reproduced in the issue states that, by the will of the people expressed at the ballot of 30 October 2022, Geraldo José Rodrigues Alckmin Filho, candidate of the Coligação Brasil da Esperança (FE Brasil (PT/PCDOB/PV)/SOLIDARIEDADE/Federação PSOL REDE (PSOL/REDE)/PSB/AGIR/AVANTE/PROS), was elected Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil, qualifying him for investiture before Congress on 1 January 2023; it is dated Brasília, 12 December 2022, and signed by Minister Alexandre de Moraes as President.

locator.section: diploma image (item 2.1.1 of the summary: 'Diplomas do Sr. Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva e do Sr. Geraldo José Rodrigues Alckmin Filho'); page 21 is its blank reverse

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The signed Termo de Posse records that at 15:00 on 1 January 2023, before Congress in joint session in the Chamber's plenary, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Geraldo José Rodrigues Alckmin Filho were solemnly empossados under art. 78 of the Constitution as President and Vice-President, respectively, elected on 30 October 2022 and diplomados by the TSE on 12 December 2022, for the period 1 January 2023 to 4 January 2027.

locator.section: Termo de posse with the signatures (item 2.1.2 of the summary)

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The signed Termo de Compromisso records the oath under art. 78 of the Constitution given on 1 January 2023 by Geraldo José Rodrigues Alckmin Filho, 'eleito para o cargo de Vice-Presidente da República em 30 de outubro de 2022 e diplomado em 12 de dezembro de 2022'.

locator.section: Termo de compromisso with signature (item 2.1.3 of the summary)

source_review.remaining_gaps: The reviewer's 24,950,158-byte body was not kept and no copy exists on this machine, so which bytes differed cannot be shown, and its fetch time is not in the evidence. This service has returned damaged HTTP 200 bodies before: the CLAUDE-C01-17 verification received 19,397,271 bytes from this URL at 01:34:49 UTC on 25 September 2026 (SHA-256 2bc18af6e3758b2512d2afc3f813f7e2d450497d9ea94bf28192c810ec065977, not a prefix of the recorded file either) and the recorded identity six minutes later, and the CLAUDE-C01-10 and CLAUDE-C01-17 reports record other short Senate transfers. Origin responses are chunked with no Content-Length, so a damaged body cannot be recognised from the headers: a re-download that is not 24,950,218 bytes should be retried, or checked against the raw Internet Archive capture, which serves Content-Length 24950218. The Senate's verification service (sigadweb/v.aspx) was not queried and the QR codes were not decoded; only the printed verification code is recorded.
source_review.independent_review_qualification: Codex independently retrieved the exact current official URL and the stated raw 2023 Archive capture on 28 September 2026 with ordinary requests; both returned the recorded 24,950,218-byte SHA-256 identity. This supports reproducibility of these observations, not an endpoint immutability guarantee. An Age: 0 header alone does not prove direct origin contact. The former d9808101...f6a619 body is unavailable: its differing bytes and cause remain unresolved; it must not be classified as damaged or content-equivalent without the body. Any future mismatch should be retained with headers and UTC before a separately recorded retry. No signature-service or QR validation was performed.
